{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for missing values
print(sales.isnull().sum())

# Check unique values in channel and converted
print('\nUnique values in channel:', sales['channel'].unique())
print('Unique values in converted:', sales['converted'].unique())

# Check distribution of channels
print('\nChannel distribution:\n', sales['channel'].value_counts())

# Check conversion rates by channel
conversion_rates = sales.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()
print('\nConversion rates by channel:\n', conversion_rates)"}
